node.statement: Correction to the exhaustive wording of node 1.4.4: the derivation also uses the phase-balanced coefficient data supplied by lem-kitaev-diagonal-repair, namely that the index set is finite and every q_t is nonnegative (indeed sum_t q_t=1). Thus, after the matrix-level identity is established using exact centrality together with linearity and involution preservation of tilde-Delta, complete positivity of Phi makes each Phi_n(Z_t^dagger Z_t) positive, and finiteness plus q_t>=0 makes their weighted sum positive. No step in either the identity or this positivity argument replaces tilde-Delta(AB) by tilde-Delta(A)tilde-Delta(B); hence exact multiplicativity of tilde-Delta is not required. The phrase used only in node 1.4.4 must be read with this coefficient hypothesis added.
